_comment: Frozen identity of every problem key the app showed as of 20 Nov 2026, written once
from the then-current data/a2z-sheet.json. build-a2z-sheet.mjs attaches each key to
exactly this TUF item ({slug, occ}: occ is the slug's occurrence index, because TUF
reuses slugs such as basic-hashing) BEFORE any automatic matching runs, so a re-scrape
can add problems but never silently re-point a key at a different one. `carried` keys
have no TUF item (Striver dropped them; see CARRIED). `steps` pins each module title's
step key, which user_settings.focus.stepKey and the sidebar collapse state store.
Add newly built keys here only by re-running the anchoring with care; never edit by hand
to 'fix' a mapping — use REHOME in build-a2z-sheet.mjs, which documents why.
